glyph.isekai_mahou.explosive_seal.desc: Engraves a trap rune on the ground that explodes when an enemy steps on it (spares allies and blocks).
glyph.isekai_mahou.teleport_circle.desc: Draws a fixed circle on the ground. With two circles, stepping on one takes you to the other. Cast on your own circle to undo it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.return_rune.desc: Focus for 3s (without moving or taking damage) to return to your last circle or your bed. Inverted, it banishes an enemy far away.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ward.desc: Raises a barrier for 10 minutes: monsters are pushed out and enemy projectiles shatter on it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.temp_enchant.desc: Enchants your held item for 5 minutes (Sharpness, Fire Aspect, Knockback, Efficiency...) depending on the spell element and item type. The old levels return afterwards.
glyph.isekai_mahou.hex.desc: Curses the target with Weakness, Slowness and a light Corruption.
glyph.isekai_mahou.voodoo_doll.desc: Binds you to the target for 60s: the next hit you would take goes to it instead (Amplify: more hits and more damage).
glyph.isekai_mahou.evil_eye.desc: Bad luck: the target misses attacks, harvests less and becomes Exposed (takes more damage).
glyph.isekai_mahou.frogify.desc: Turns a common mob (not a boss, up to 20 hearts) into a frog for 20s. Then it returns exactly as it was.
glyph.isekai_mahou.familiar.desc: On yourself: summons a Crow for 10 minutes (sneaking: a Cat). The crow pecks enemies and fetches items; the cat scares creepers and phantoms.
glyph.isekai_mahou.wolf_form.desc: Become a wolf: small, fast, with a strong bite on wounded foes; sniffs out nearby monsters. Cast again to change back.
glyph.isekai_mahou.bear_form.desc: Become a bear: big, tough, with swipes that knock back and slow. Cast again to change back.
glyph.isekai_mahou.falcon_form.desc: Become a falcon: in the air, glide by holding forward and jump to flap your wings (4 times per flight). No fall damage.
glyph.isekai_mahou.dolphin_form.desc: Become a dolphin: swims very fast, breathes and sees underwater, but is slow on land.
glyph.isekai_mahou.spider_form.desc: Become a spider: climb walls (sneak to cling), see in the dark and poison with your bite.
Become a huge beast of the spell's element, with elemental strikes and passives (fire: fireproof; earth: resistance; wind: no fall damage...).

message.isekai_mahou.origins_a.recall_hu: The hit broke your focus: the Return Rune faded.

message.isekai_mahou.origins_a.recall_sp: No bed or circle: you returned to the world spawn.

message.isekai_mahou.origins_a.enchant_m: This item already has enchantments as strong as the rune's.
